entries.subject: case:blocked-predicate-unmapped-code__constraint_check_typed

The case lives in codegen's home (D14), not agentic-mbse's package: the records cannot cite it for the refused pair, because a cited refused case must show the mapped code (SI_CONSTRAINT_BLOCKED) and this one does not.
